chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch 183: The Dark-Iron Seal Strikes - Little Defiant Dragon's Victory and Sorrow
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen heals the Little Defiant Dragon with the sacred tree, faces a brutal challenger, and unleashes the Dark-Iron Seal's power. The Undying Sect elder intervenes.
og_title: World of Immortality: Chapter 183 - The Dark-Iron Seal's Wrath
og_description: In a tragic victory, the Little Defiant Dragon defeats the Golden Dragon King. Xiao Chen uses an ancient artifact to crush an arrogant foe, but deeper forces are at play.
twitter_description: The Little Defiant Dragon's victory brings grief and a new enemy. Xiao Chen taps into the power of the Dark-Iron Seal.
